Grid 6 by 6. Zero-based ( row , col ). Rows increase down; columns increase right. Start ( 4 , 2 ). Goal ( 4 , 1 ). Obstacles ( 2 , 4 ) ; ( 3 , 3 ) ; ( 5 , 3 ).
